class Point
  attr_reader :x, :y

  def initialize(x, y)
    @x = x
    @y = y
  end

  def eql?(other)
    other.is_a?(Point) && self.x == other.x && self.y == other.y
  end

  alias_method :==, :eql?

  def hash
    [self.class, self.x, self.y].hash
  end

  def inspect
    "#<#{self.class.name}(x=#{@x}, y=#{@y})>"
  end
end
